question: Can concise generation complete the operator-authored tri-radial lower skeleton while preserving three distinct support chains?
namedConsumer: the operator-authored envelope and Trellis reconstruction loop
boundedClaim: A positive cell may establish that one 2D proposal preserves a legible three-support interpretation under the effective FLUX route.
falsifyingObservation: The output collapses the source into an ordinary bilateral quadruped, erases a support chain, or loses the authored pelvic relation.
claimCeiling: No cell establishes 3D topology, anatomical correctness, production viability, or motion compatibility.

conditioningPlate.derivation: Aspect-preserving pad to square with dark gray background, then Lanczos scale to 512x512.

inspectionPolicy: Classify every output, but expose only positively classified outputs to the operator unless the operator explicitly requests the rest.
